summary.text: Bob Donovan is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 61 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Robert Donovan, also known as Bob, was born in and lives in Wisconsin and graduated from Thomas More High School, according to Ballotpedia.
He attended St. Francis De Sales College, the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee and Marquette University, and served on the board of directors of the Southside Organizing Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Donovan as having served on the Milwaukee Common Council, District 8, from 2000 to 2020.

Donovan was assigned to the Urban Revitalization Committee as chair, the Local Government Committee as vice-chair, and the Criminal Justice and Public Safety and Judiciary committees for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
